The supplied source_variables do not include qlist, hidspec, hidquota2, or hidquota3, so specialty/list-dependent termination thresholds and on-list rules cannot be generated without introducing unmapped variables.
The state, consent, specialty, and practice-status termination values are validated as domains; termination status itself is application-handled and is not inferred from response data.
Whole-number enforcement for numeric fields is not generated because the supplied SPSS macros support bounds but no mapped integer-schema predicate.

The q130 grids are not generated as macro calls because their 14 separate attribute spans require analyst confirmation of physical SAV contiguity and row-level visibility filters; no unsupported TO span was introduced.
q115 and q130 visibility depends on q110 awareness. The q115 domain check is generated, but q115 missingness is not independently flagged outside its documented visibility condition.
The supplied test-token rule is applied to q137 only in this block; other mapped open-text fields are covered by their owning blocks.
Downstream routing is checked only for respondents with q205=1; q205=2 is treated as a valid skip condition.

The q250 and q255 multiple-choice sets are not passed to a macro because the supplied evidence does not specify a physical contiguous span that excludes the linked text fields and preserves the intended displayed order.
q345 is checked only when q340=1, and q355 is checked only when q350_5=1 or q350_6=1, consistent with the supplied routing.
The q350 response-set exclusivity rule for q350_10 is not generated because the source specification does not provide a confirmed physical contiguous span for a safe approved macro call.
Whole-number enforcement for d2_1 is not generated because the supplied approved macros provide numeric bounds but no mapped integer-schema predicate.
